info.name: HLabs DXB - Dubai Land Department Registry Gateway
info.description: Audited and revised from hlabs-dxb on 28 July 2026. Covers offices, brokers and POST /open-data/projects. Registry runtime and dormant helpers are labelled; the projects request is parameterized for all four required date selectors. Saved 200 examples preserve every response field and data type. Personal registry examples are sanitized; project data is public DLD project data.

variable.description: Public consumer ID currently checked into the project. Move to a private environment if DLD changes its access model.
1=start, 2=end, 3=adoption/registration, 4=completion. The application runs all four and deduplicates the union.
Use 1 for diagnostics. The production sync uses -1 to retrieve the complete selector window in one call.

item.description: Both requests are used on every registry sync. pageIndex is zero-based; short pages are not terminal because the gateway repeats and drops rows across boundaries.

item.name: 02 - Runtime roster reconciliation
item.description: Used after the bulk crawl to obtain an exact broker roster for selected offices. The regular run selects recently licensed, zero-broker and newly seen offices; the deep run selects every active office.

header.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/131.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
header.description: Required: the gateway returns 403 to plain/non-browser clients.

request.description: USED. GET /brokers/?officeNumber=. The code uses pageSize=500. At the audited snapshot the largest office has 468 active brokers, so every current office fits in one logical request, excluding retries.

exec: pm.test('All returned brokers match officeNumber', () => { body.Response.forEach(r => pm.expect(String(r.RealEstateNumber)).to.equal(String(pm.variables.get('officeNumber')))); });
